questions.text: “Spiritual Bypass Warning” (##) has no text of its own. Under it are “Realization Isn’t Enough” (your bypassing story and how to tell fake gurus) and “Friends Are Everything” (community, peer counseling). 10 of 10 readers called it hard. Readers looking for how to tell a real teacher from a fake one stop at it, and clicking it lands on “Realization Isn’t Enough”, so they get there. Keep it, rename it to cover both (Fable’s idea: “Before You Start”, which fits), or drop it so the two stand as ## headings? Dropping it changes the post’s structure, not just a name.

“Loving-Kindness (Mettā)” is a ### under “Enlightened or Deluded?”, but it’s the next step of your story: you start mettā, it cures your depression, and you learn that people who hate themselves need a loving inner adult first. “Why Monks Stay Vague” later calls it “the loving kindness key”. 7 of 10 readers called it hard. Make it a ## of its own? And the 🫶🏿 blessing (“May All Beings Be Loving, Peaceful & Free”) leaves the heading in every version: open the section with it as a line of its own?

“Enlightened Fingers” is a ### under “The Room Event”, but it’s a second event, “some months after” the room, asleep in a parked car. Make it a ## beside “The Room Event”, with “Two Scopes of Nibbāna” (which compares the two) after it? Your whole line (“Your fingers are already enlightened, but your hand is deluded.”) can’t fit as a heading: open the section with it?

“Who Gets Reborn?” and “Waking From the Dream” sit under “What Is Stream Entry?”, but they’re about rebirth and the dream analogy. Your heading for the parent was “Entering The Stream To End Rebirth”. Put them under a ## of their own (“Ending Rebirth”, its second half), or leave them? Readers found “Who Gets Reborn?” where it is.

“Appendix” (#) has no text and one section: Vanishing "I": Dangerous? (your micro-disappearances, and whether biking or driving through one is safe). 7 of 10 readers called it hard. Keep it, drop “Appendix” so the section is its own #, or move the section into the manual after “What Remains Afterward”?

Renaming takes some of your own words out of the contents: “dangerous or cool?” (the appendix), “Light Language Like Chantress Seba Never Seen Before!” with its link to her YouTube channel (the link goes too unless it moves into that section’s first line), “Body-Limited and Body-Uncontained” (defined in that section’s first lines anyway), the blessing and the fingers line (both above). Which, if any, should open its section as a line of its own, and where should the Chantress Seba link go?
